instruction: Help me make the mouse pointer move more quickly by raising its speed.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because mouse pointer speed and acceleration are input device settings that cannot be programmatically verified in the OSWorld environment. While these settings can be adjusted through system preferences, there is no reliable way to measure or confirm the actual pointer speed/sensitivity setting through the evaluation framework.

llm_judge_reasons: The evaluator correctly uses the 'infeasible' function for a task that cannot be programmatically verified
The reasoning is sound: mouse pointer speed/sensitivity settings are subjective input device configurations that cannot be reliably measured through the OSWorld evaluation framework
While the system settings GUI can be accessed and modified, there is no practical way to verify the actual pointer speed value or confirm the setting was changed correctly
The infeasible designation is semantically appropriate for this type of system preference task
